nodes.g: Zabdi = "endowment" son of Zerah and grandson of Judah;
Joash = "Jehovah hastens" a Benjamite, son of Becher one of the officers in David's court
Gederite = "a wall" an inhabitant of Geder
Ramathite = see Ramah "the height" an inhabitant of Ramah
Siphmoth = "fruitful" a place in the Nekeb in southern Judah
Ezri = "help of Jehovah" son of Chelub and superintendent of king David's farm labourers
